prompt: Concept art of a single fantasy elven longbow, a game item, shown alone in side view, standing diagonally from lower left to upper right, centred on a plain pale grey background. The limbs are broad and chunky so the bow reads clearly at small size. One bow only, no arrow, no hand, no stand, no other objects. Stylised low-poly toy-miniature look, flat matte colours, soft even lighting, no outlines, no text. Palette: dusty sage, rust, ochre and bone.
